title.en: An Act Establishing a District Office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the Municipality of Mamburao, Province of Occidental Mindoro and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a District Office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the Municipality of Mamburao, Province of Occidental Mindoro and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Văn phòng Khu vực Land Transportation Office tại Đô thị Mamburao, Tỉnh Occidental Mindoro, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งสำนักงานเขต Land Transportation Office ในเทศบาล Mamburao จังหวัด Occidental Mindoro และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk sebuah Kantor Distrik Land Transportation Office di Kotamadya Mamburao, Provinsi Occidental Mindoro, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan sebuah Pejabat Daerah Land Transportation Office di Perbandaran Mamburao, Wilayah Occidental Mindoro, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: There shall be established a district office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the Municipality of Mamburao, Province of Occidental Mindoro.

The Secretary of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department’s programs the operationalization of the LTO District Office in the Municipality of Mamburao, Province of Occidental Mindoro, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
